title: Allude
summary: ALLU'DE, verb intransitive [Latin alludo, to smile upon or make sport with of ad and ludo, to play.] To refer to something not directly mentioned; to have reference; to hint at by remote suggestions;

inlines.v: ALLU'DE, verb intransitive [Latin alludo, to smile upon or make sport with of ad and ludo, to play.] To refer to something not directly mentioned; to have reference; to hint at by remote suggestions; as, that story alludes to a recent transaction.
